summary: Exit code 2 from clamscan discards all parsed findings; the core error-counting branch never runs in production
evidence: clamav.rs:79-87 match exit code: only 0 or 1 parse stdout; any other code returns Probe. scan.rs:43-44 counts " ERROR" lines.
failure_scenario: Recursive scan with locked files (for example NTUSER.DAT) plus one infected file: an error is shown and the infected file is not reported. UNVERIFIED: that clamscan exits 2 with per-file errors and still prints FOUND lines; clamscan source is not in the repo.
